records.algorithm_name: P3 fresh witness plus bounded reduction-forest memory order

parameters.selection: strictly smaller official Makespan than fresh witness incumbent

timing.evaluation_precision: External perf_counter whole-child wall; no standalone external final-evaluation timer.

solver.method: Fresh witness incumbent, then at most one graph-derived reduction-forest order if total online E0 calls remain below three; accept only strict official Makespan improvement. No per-case lookup or historical plan reuse.

measurement.solver_scope: Fresh child spawn through reaped exit: interpreter/import, read graph, construct, integrated E0 selection/verification, final plan and evidence writes, required cleanup. External parent preflight excluded and retained in batch wall.
measurement.evaluation_scope: No separate external final evaluation. Integrated E0 calls are included in solver wall; internal diagnostics are retained in trace and are not substituted for external timing.
measurement.offline_costs: Fresh witness full500 and its same-plan no-L2 pair were separate earlier experiments. Forest two-graph mechanism test used two constructors and four external official E0; no previous result substitutes any cell here. Fixed source has 184 passed tests, one explicit E0 opt-in skipped, and ten relevant tests passed after the final guard.

missing_reasons.provenance.environment.peak_rss_bytes: Per-child peak RSS was not measured; no aggregate/high-water proxy is substituted.

timing.evaluation_precision: External perf_counter whole-child wall; no standalone external final-evaluation timer.

solver.method: Fresh witness incumbent, then at most one graph-derived reduction-forest order if total online E0 calls remain below three; accept only strict official Makespan improvement. No per-case lookup or historical plan reuse.

measurement.solver_scope: Fresh child spawn through reaped exit: interpreter/import, read graph, construct, integrated E0 selection/verification, final plan and evidence writes, required cleanup. External parent preflight excluded and retained in batch wall.
measurement.evaluation_scope: No separate external final evaluation. Integrated E0 calls are included in solver wall; internal diagnostics are retained in trace and are not substituted for external timing.
measurement.offline_costs: Fresh witness full500 and its same-plan no-L2 pair were separate earlier experiments. Forest two-graph mechanism test used two constructors and four external official E0; no previous result substitutes any cell here. Fixed source has 184 passed tests, one explicit E0 opt-in skipped, and ten relevant tests passed after the final guard.

timing.evaluation_precision: External perf_counter whole-child wall; no standalone external final-evaluation timer.

solver.method: Fresh witness incumbent, then at most one graph-derived reduction-forest order if total online E0 calls remain below three; accept only strict official Makespan improvement. No per-case lookup or historical plan reuse.

measurement.solver_scope: Fresh child spawn through reaped exit: interpreter/import, read graph, construct, integrated E0 selection/verification, final plan and evidence writes, required cleanup. External parent preflight excluded and retained in batch wall.
measurement.evaluation_scope: No separate external final evaluation. Integrated E0 calls are included in solver wall; internal diagnostics are retained in trace and are not substituted for external timing.
measurement.offline_costs: Fresh witness full500 and its same-plan no-L2 pair were separate earlier experiments. Forest two-graph mechanism test used two constructors and four external official E0; no previous result substitutes any cell here. Fixed source has 184 passed tests, one explicit E0 opt-in skipped, and ten relevant tests passed after the final guard.
